oneSentenceConcept: The hero becomes a living material stage where identity morphs through typographic hierarchy, and archive presence shares the same continuum as current craft without becoming a showreel or dashboard.
heroConcept: Overscaled stacked type occupies a cinematic band as living material — weight and tracking shift on scroll as one morphing identity thread. A thin oxide material rule and a bounded technical texture reveal on focus mark craft presence; archive-like fragment labels stay subordinate to hierarchy.

visualLanguage: Cool mineral paper and near-black establish a bipartite craft field; overscaled grotesk type acts as living material while a deep oxide accent and exact borders mark process presence without cream-editorial softness.
interactionLanguage: Scroll morphs hero type material as one causal thread; pointer and keyboard focus expose the same technical texture cue. Navigation, links, and supporting sections retain conventional behavior and visible focus states.
motionLanguage: One hero-only morphing material sequence with short deceleration — type weight/tracking shift plus material-rule extension. Supporting sections use restrained opacity and border-state changes only; no looping ambience.
storytellingApproach: Hero as living craft stage and prologue; supporting sections resolve into a calm linear record so archive presence never competes with comprehension.

typographyDirection: Overscaled bold grotesk for the hero material stage, compact uppercase fragment labels, and a stable sans body with generous line height; avoid serif-editorial signaling.
compositionDirection: Cinematic-band hero with stacked typographic material and subordinate fragment labels; supporting sections return to an airy grid rhythm with muted bands.
colorDirection: Cool mineral paper background, near-black text, and one deep oxide accent with AA contrast; muted stone surfaces separate context without warm cream or atmospheric gradients.
textureDirection: Flat mineral surfaces, exact one-pixel rules, and a bounded technical texture only on focus; depth comes from material morph and overlap rather than glass, grain, or glow.
